about: Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc., a media and content company, operates specialty and conventional television networks, and radio stations in Canada and internationally. It operates through three segments: Television, Radio and Content Production. The Television segment operates specialty television networks, conventional television stations, digital and streaming platforms, social digital agency, and social media creator network, as well as provides technology and media services; and provides over-the-air broadcast television. This segment is also involved in the production and distribution of films and television programs; merchandise licensing and book publishing activities; and the provision of advertising services, subscriptions, and the licensing of proprietary films and television programs. In addition, its specialty television networks operate in the discretionary services, which include news, arts, children's, drama, lifestyle, and entertainment programming. The Radio segment operates radio stations that include various formats, such as news/talk, classic hits, rock, country, and hot adult contemporary radio, as well as offers podcasting and streaming services. The Content Production segment provides series and storytelling content. Corus Entertainment Holdings Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
